assertions.description: WebTransport.prototype.getStats is a function: the method that returns a Promise<WebTransportConnectionStats>.
getStats() returns a Promise even for a session that is still connecting (it must not throw synchronously).
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const p = t.getStats(); p.catch(() => {}); return p instanceof Promise; })()

assertions.description: getStats() called while connecting waits for the outcome and, when the handshake fails, rejects with InvalidStateError instead of resolving with stats.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); try { await t.getStats(); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()

assertions.description: Once ready has rejected (state "failed"), getStats() rejects with InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats !== 'function') return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.closed.catch(() => {}); try { await t.ready; return false; } catch {} try { await t.getStats(); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()

assertions.description: On an established session getStats() resolves to a dictionary whose required datagrams member is a WebTransportDatagramStats object.
assertions.test: Needs a reachable HTTP/3 WebTransport server (UDP). Observe at /v159/webtransport-connection-statistics/stats-snapshot/ with a reachable endpoint.

assertions.description: After close() and closed settling, getStats() resolves with the most recent stats instead of rejecting.
assertions.test: Needs an established session. Observe via run 3 at /v159/webtransport-connection-statistics/lifecycle-states/.

assertions.description: A stats member exposed in one getStats() result is present in every later result for the same session.
assertions.test: Needs an established session and two calls. Observe with 'Call getStats() again' at /v159/webtransport-connection-statistics/stats-snapshot/.

assertions.description: estimatedSendRate is either null (no estimate) or a non-negative integer number of bits per second.
assertions.test: Needs an established session. Observe in the live readout at /v159/webtransport-connection-statistics/health-monitor/.
